reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the record supports it: the cited Section 8.2 is a product/commercial exclusivity covenant (Competing Products) with no personnel solicitation, hiring or inducement language, and the rationale reports that searches for solicit/hire/induce/recruit terms return nothing elsewhere in the Agreement.

NOSOLICIT's preferred position is that no non-solicit binds the Customer; absence of any such covenant therefore sits at preferred, so no redline or comment is expected, and none was proposed (redline is byte-identical to the original).
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure and do not indicate a defect in the finding.
Correctly scoped: the drafter notes the Section 8.2 exclusivity restraint belongs under a non-compete/exclusivity rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
